Initial release of yotta-publish-guard: a comprehensive pre-publish gatekeeper for yotta skills.

- Provides CLI commands to check, pack, verify version alignment, name duplication, and publish across GitHub, npm, and ClawHub.
- Supports three verification modes: full, github-only, and self-use, for flexible validation scopes.
- Aggregates safety, review, and trust verdicts; defaults to blocking publish on check failures, with explicit --force override.
- Ensures essential files inclusion, version consistency, and three-channel name duplication checks.
- Dry-run is default for publish; supports explicit execution and customizable channels.
- Respects network availability and boundaries; does not automate publishing decisions or content development.
